market_definition: The Global Antioxidants Market covers chemical antioxidant additives used in rubber, elastomers, plastics and polymer formulations to prevent oxidative degradation during processing and service life: aromatic amine, hindered phenolic, phosphite and phosphonite, thioester and other antioxidants, in powder, liquid, flake, pellet / granule and pre-dispersed / emulsified forms, for natural rubber, SBR, BR, NBR, ABS, latex, thermoplastic elastomers and other polymers, used in tires and tire components, industrial rubber products, rubber and latex gloves, foams, adhesives and tapes, plastic and polymer compounding and wire and cable, for heat and thermal-oxidation protection, processing stability, long-term aging, ozone / weathering protection and color retention, across automotive, industrial, healthcare, construction, electrical and electronics and consumer products, sold direct and through distributors.
core_scope: A core player itself produces and sells under its own name rubber / polymer antioxidant additives (aromatic amine, hindered phenolic, phosphite / phosphonite, thioester or other antioxidant stabilizers and blends) -- including diversified chemical groups for which these additives are one product line.
adjacent_segments: Food, beverage, supplement, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical or cosmetic antioxidants
Standalone antiozonants, UV absorbers or light stabilizers without antioxidant function
Polymer masterbatch and compound makers selling finished formulations
Tire, glove, rubber-goods and plastic-product makers (the customers)
Upstream raw-material and intermediate producers not selling finished antioxidant additives
scope: ONLY producers of rubber / polymer antioxidant ADDITIVES sold under their own name: aromatic amine, hindered phenolic, phosphite and phosphonite, thioester and other antioxidant stabilizers for rubber, elastomers, plastics and polymers. A diversified chemical group with such an additive line qualifies. EXCLUDED: food, beverage, supplement, pharmaceutical and cosmetic antioxidants; standalone antiozonants, UV absorbers and light stabilizers without antioxidant function; finished rubber / plastic products (tires, gloves, components); upstream raw materials and intermediates not sold as finished antioxidants; masterbatch and compound makers selling finished formulations; distributors, traders and resellers.
